description: Planned menu-family × native-state × VR-presentation obligations. These are not an enumeration of every native page. Discover and retain each child page, legal choice and transition before claiming complete menu coverage.

modes.title: Title / helicopter cabin
modes.emplacement: Turret / mortar station; split by native role during discovery
modes.walker: Walker Gear / D-Walker; split by native role during discovery
modes.results: Mission clear / abort results; split during discovery

acceptance: Record exact native state, page, parent page, selected choice, enabled/locked choices and eligibility; an open-menu flag is insufficient.
Use the effective VR bindings and observe the actual page/choice response, including tab changes, scrolling, cursor edges and map pan/zoom where applicable.
Visit every discovered child page and legal confirmation/cancel branch. Verify actual action completion; delivered input alone is insufficient.
Back out from each depth, close, immediately reopen, and verify locomotion/combat input ownership and neutral controls recover.
Review complete final-eye sequences for both eyes: readable text, uncropped choices, correct attachment, head/hand motion and stable stereo without blinking.
Confirm physical-headset reading, controller usability, scale and comfort separately from simulator observations.
safety: Read-only discovery first. Purchases, upgrades, deployment, abort/retry and progression-changing confirmations require an isolated verified save/checkpoint fixture. An ambiguous page never admits generic Confirm or repeated Back.
variant_policy: These are independent discovery obligations, not a Cartesian enumeration or a count of the game's menus. Applicability and legal combinations remain unknown until witnessed in the native game. Retain each discovered combination with its actual page, progression, owner and build; one ordinary-page pass does not cover another variant.

values.title: First-time guidance
acceptance: Establish whether this menu has a first-time branch from genuine native campaign history; an existing-save clone or reset flag is not first-play evidence.
Record the actual mission/sequence, tutorial mode/name and prerequisites; use effective VR bindings for the required entry, selection and permitted exit without bypassing guidance.

values.title: Unfinished or resumed guidance
acceptance: Identify an actually unfinished lesson and its restricted choices, native input owner and permitted continuation/stow behavior.

Closing a Help card may leave guidance active: native mode 14 SERVER_WALLET continues through the highlighted Resources branch and a second card. Discover the complete native sequence before expecting mode zero or ordinary tab navigation; see docs/ACC_MENU_REGRESSION.md.
Exercise the legal VR continuation, acknowledgment or cancel/stow and immediate reopen; retain native progression and reject leaked gameplay inputs.

values.title: Completed guidance
acceptance: Witness the native completed state independently of an empty tutorial-mode field or a high-progress save.
Verify ordinary navigation, retained Help/notice dismissal, Back, stow and immediate reopen; confirm input ownership returns without reapplying completed guidance.

values.title: Ordinary page
acceptance: Identify the actual settled page, parent and selectable/disabled choices with no unresolved confirmation or Help owner.
Observe VR selection, navigation, tabs and legal Back/stow/reopen responses; mapped input alone is not a page outcome.

values.title: Confirmation or cancellation
acceptance: Discover whether this path presents a confirmation and record its purpose, exact choice owner, default selection and legal confirm/cancel branches.

Use effective VR navigation and review the actual resulting state/resource change or cancellation. Progression-changing confirmation requires the verified isolated fixture stated in the safety policy.

values.title: Help, tutorial or acknowledgment
acceptance: Identify the actual Help/tutorial/notice and its pause/input owner; a generic popup flag does not identify the card or authorize acknowledgment.
Exercise its permitted VR acknowledgment or exit, then verify the underlying page and immediate reopen with fresh neutral input and no stale modal ownership.

values.title: Locked by prerequisites
acceptance: Record the native item/grade and unmet prerequisite that locks it; discover whether selection is disabled or opens a requirements page.
Verify its legal VR inspection and Back/cancel/reopen without granting prerequisites or spending resources.

values.title: Insufficient resources
acceptance: Witness actual costs and balances for an otherwise identified item/grade; distinguish resource insufficiency from other locked prerequisites.
Observe the native disabled/rejection response and legal VR Back/cancel/reopen without fabricating resource balances.

values.title: Eligible and undeveloped
acceptance: Verify the exact native item/grade is eligible and not developed; record prerequisites, costs, time and the actual confirmation owner.
Exercise cancellation separately from an authorized isolated-fixture purchase, verifying actual resource changes and native development start rather than input delivery.

values.title: Development in progress
acceptance: Witness native development-in-progress state and its displayed timer/status without forcing time or completion.
Verify available VR inspection/navigation and legal Back/reopen while retaining the same development transaction.

values.title: Newly completed development
acceptance: Retain an actual native transition to completed development, including any notification and changed item availability; a completion write is not evidence.
Use effective VR acknowledgment and revisit the item/grade, checking its new state and recovery of underlying input ownership.

values.title: Already developed
acceptance: Verify the exact native item/grade was already developed before entry, separately from requirements-met or a neighboring grade.
Inspect its native detail/selection behavior with VR controls and verify legal Back/reopen without an unintended duplicate transaction.

reports.title: ACC upgrade-menu lock-up
reports.summary: Another player reports an upgrade-menu lock-up in the ACC. Exact development/customization screen is unknown; field list/Back evidence does not reproduce it.

reports.title: Development upgrade lock-up in ACC or on foot
reports.summary: The latest report concerns Development/upgrading in the ACC and on foot. The exact category, grade, step and guidance state remain unknown. Earlier or incomplete campaign progress is suspected, not established; an ordinary completed-save menu pass does not close this report.

limits: Applicability is not established for planned menu/state pairs. Native unavailability must be observed; it is never inferred from a missing adapter.
Progression, buddy, equipment, vehicle subtype, tutorial and confirmation variants must be discovered and retained as distinct child paths.
TPP online menu branches remain open. MGO and Ground Zeroes are separate game adapters, not covered by a TPP menu pass.
No matrix count is a percentage of the game's actual menus. Menu discovery and physical-headset acceptance remain incomplete.
